Where the two DQNs come from

Validation delay during training. The untrained controller is the episode-0 network. The trained one is the best checkpoint, from episode 135. Both are the same architecture with different weights.

The three days are held-out test scenarios, picked by DQN's margin over priority-aware across all 100: the median day, its best day and its worst. Each replay was re-run in SUMO 1.28.0 from the saved checkpoints and scenario files, and the end-of-day totals match the logged evaluation exactly. Positions are SUMO vehicle positions sampled every 10 simulated seconds and interpolated in between. The outer-signal queue and upstream reservoir are boundary queues in the adapter, so queued trains are listed rather than drawn on track. Track lengths are drawn schematically, and a train's drawn length is its share of the real lane. Timetables and delays are synthetic.
